citations.claim: energy still below bound just before violation
first violation: energy exceeds E0*1.1+5 bound

counterfactual.change: Changed body 1 restitution e from 1 to 0 (single field) to break the elastic chain/floor energy pumping; same 115 steps now passes.

explanation: Elastic chain of falling bodies plus floor bounce pumps energy: light body 2 rebounds between heavier body 1 and floor with e=1, and positional/impulse contact resolution adds net mechanical energy, growing from ~431 J at step 114 to 506.4 J at step 115, exceeding E0*1.1+5=503.3 J. Making the middle body inelastic (e=0) removes the amplification and stays below bound.
vision_note: Three bodies fall toward the bottom of the arena across steps 112 to 114, with the small upper body dropping fast toward the two larger lower bodies. At step 115 all three arrive at the floor together with the small body squeezed just above the right-hand larger body in a tight stacked contact.
